steps.what: Check actual timing-instrument repair requirements and stock and capture required replacement parts, materials and quantities
Find the actual movement-compatible catalogue parts and verify dimensions, revision, availability and price
Clarify the actual supplier's supply terms and delivery constraints without placing the order
Assemble the actual supply order from selected parts, quantities, checked terms and the shop's delivery details
Check and complete the exact commercial order and authorize purchase under the shop's actual purchasing responsibility
Place the exact authorized order with the selected parts supplier
Read the actual supplier confirmation and check it against the ordered parts and delivery terms
Retain the ordinary order copy in the same purchasing workspace

tasks.design: Link actual movement and stock references in {OTHER}, the timepiece repair and inventory system, to exact order fields in {PROCUREMENT}. Generate the proposed order and place only the commercial version completed under the shop's actual purchasing responsibility through {PARTNER_PORTAL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supply orders can repeat compatible part, quantity and delivery fields across repair and supplier systems.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit movement/catalogue keys and order mappings can transfer those selected facts.
tasks.still_hard: A nominally similar movement part may differ in dimensions, revision or fit.
tasks.human_edge: The repairer understands physical compatibility and actual repair need.

ambition.what: No autonomous part substitution or purchase decision.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: movement/catalogue links and exact order mappings can reduce repeated supply-order entry while compatibility and purchasing responsibility remain human.

assumptions: This graph applies to the actual shop arrangement with a separate purchaser completing the commercial order; confirm that actual responsibility rather than inventing a supervisor approval. A self-operated shop needs its actual purchase-decision allocation, not author self-approval of a note.

tasks.design: Reuse the existing timepiece identifier and intake headings in {OTHER}, the timepiece repair system. The repairer still gathers the actual customer's account and writes its diagnostic substance; the configuration removes repeated identity/header entry only.
tasks.previous_blocker: The actual intake record can repeat timepiece identity fields alongside the customer's specific history.
tasks.enabler_now: Native repair-case fields can carry the checked identifier into the intake entry.
tasks.still_hard: A symptom description may be intermittent, uncertain or inconsistent with previous service.
tasks.human_edge: The repairer asks the right follow-up questions and separates reported history from observed condition.

ambition.what: No automated diagnosis or repair authorization.

tasks.short: Record repaired timepieces, work and charges

steps.what: Read the actual completed repair job and capture timepiece quantities, types, serial/model identifiers, performed work and actual charge inputs
inputs: actual parts and labour charge inputs

steps.what: Populate the actual repair record's quantity, type, serial/model and specified charge fields from checked job facts
Write the actual work-performed description in the timepiece repair record
Reconcile the actual record against repaired items, performed work and actual charges and correct discrepancies
Save the ordinary repair record in the same work-order system

tasks.design: Map actual repair-job and charge fields from {OTHER}, the timepiece work-order system, and {SPREADSHEET} into the existing repair record. Reuse standard work-description headings while the repairer writes actual deviations and reconciles the complete record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repair records can require repeated job-identifier and charge copying alongside actual work descriptions.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit field mappings and native work-description sections can remove those repeated entry actions.
tasks.still_hard: The record must reflect the actual timepiece, performed work and applicable charges.
tasks.human_edge: The repairer knows when the standard description omits an actual repair detail.

ambition.what: No automated invoice issue, payment or equipment release.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit repair-job field mappings can reduce record re-entry while actual work descriptions and charge reconciliation remain human.

assumptions: The task explicitly requires actual repair records used for service history and repair-charge reference. Boundary is factual recording, not issuing an invoice or formally releasing the timepiece.
